state_machine.purpose: Power-up/reset. Fan command is OFF and the occupancy delay is reset while permit is FALSE. Temperature adjustment is still computed each scan.
Occupied non-Night operation before 30 s maturity. Fan remains OFF; TON accumulates continuously.
Occupied non-Night operation after the delay has matured. Fan is ON while permit remains TRUE.

timer_plan.name: TON_OccupancyDelay
timer_plan.Q: TRUE only after permit has been continuously TRUE for at least 30 s; FALSE otherwise.
timer_plan.notes: Call unconditionally at top level every scan outside CASE/IF. The first non-Night occupied invocation starts ET at zero; the first observation at or after 30 s may assert Q and fan in the same scan. Recovery after any reset requires a new full 30 s.

priorities: 1. Immediate safety/reset: if occupancy is lost or Night mode is selected, force SUPPLY_FAN_RUN = FALSE, reset the 30 s delay, and return the fan state machine to S0_RESET_OFF.
2. Initialization: pre-invocation outputs are SUPPLY_FAN_RUN = FALSE and TEMP_SETPOINT_ADJUST = 0; normal scan calculation updates them immediately from current inputs.
3. Night override: HVAC_MODE_SELECTOR = 3 gives TEMP_SETPOINT_ADJUST = +4 regardless of occupancy and energy saving.
5. Unoccupied non-Night: Auto uses +3 when ENERGY_SAVING_MODE is TRUE, otherwise +2; Comfort uses +1; Economy uses +4. Energy saving affects Auto only.
7. The delay only gates the BOOL SUPPLY_FAN_RUN; no speed ramp is generated.

scan_execution_order.name: edge sampling
actions: Record previous sampled values for reset/diagnostic edge detection; no outputs are written.

scan_execution_order.name: safety/reset priority and state transitions
actions: If NOT permit, force state := S0_RESET_OFF and request delay reset.
Else evaluate state transitions using permit, current state, and timer maturity.
State transitions occur before the timer FB call; no timer FB call is made here.

scan_execution_order.name: unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF
actions: Call TON_OccupancyDelay(IN := permit, PT := T#30S) once every scan at top level.
When permit is FALSE, the timer resets ET/Q. When permit is TRUE after a reset, timing restarts from zero.

scan_execution_order.name: unified output assignments
actions: Compute tempAdjCalc from current inputs: Night => +4; else occupied => 0; else Auto unoccupied => +3 with energy saving or +2 without; Comfort unoccupied => +1; Economy unoccupied => +4.
Clamp tempAdjCalc to [-4, +4] and assign TEMP_SETPOINT_ADJUST once.
Assign SUPPLY_FAN_RUN := (state <> S0_RESET_OFF) AND permit AND TON_OccupancyDelay.Q, giving immediate OFF on permit loss and same-scan ON at timer maturity.

formal_assertions.formula: G((HVAC_MODE_SELECTOR = 0 AND NOT OCCUPANCY_DETECTED AND ENERGY_SAVING_MODE) -> (TEMP_SETPOINT_ADJUST = 3))
G((HVAC_MODE_SELECTOR = 0 AND NOT OCCUPANCY_DETECTED AND NOT ENERGY_SAVING_MODE) -> (TEMP_SETPOINT_ADJUST = 2))
